summary: Iteration 5 testing — Saved Photos gallery + enriched GET /api/photos/bookmarks. Backend: 3/3 new iter5 pytest cases pass covering (a) 401 unauth, (b) empty [] when no bookmarks, (c) reverse-chronological ordering + enriched fields (hotel_name, hotel_destination, like_count, bookmark_count, my_liked reflecting caller's like state, my_bookmarked=true always, url) across hotels htl_01 & htl_03, no _id leakage, and toggle-off unbookmark drops the photo from the list. Full regression: 71/71 pass across iter1-5 (the previously flaky test_travelo_iter2.py::TestEmails::test_emails_mine_lists_mocked also passed this run). Frontend: cookie-injected session + one seeded paid booking + one uploaded+bookmarked photo → nav-saved-photos link present when authed, saved-photos-page renders with saved-photo-<pid> tile showing the correct hotel_name ('The Coral Vault') and /hotels/htl_01 link, saved-like-btn count goes 0→1 with orange fill after click, clicking the tile opens saved-lightbox with saved-lightbox-unsave button, clicking Saved removes the tile immediately, closes the lightbox, and shows saved-photos-empty block with CTA. Unauth flow: /saved-photos renders saved-photos-unauth block and Nav 'Saved' link is hidden.
action_items: OPTIONAL: server.py has grown to 1140 lines with iter5 additions — split into routers (routers/photos.py for uploads+reactions+bookmarks, routers/wishlist.py, routers/bookings.py, routers/concierge.py). This has been recommended across iter2/iter3/iter4/iter5.

OPTIONAL: GET /api/photos/bookmarks silently drops orphaned bookmarks whose hotel_photo row was deleted. Consider cleaning up orphan photo_reactions when photos are deleted, or surfacing them so the user knows.

OPTIONAL: /api/photos/bookmarks now issues 3 mongo round-trips (reactions.find, hotel_photos.find, aggregate for counts, plus another find for my_liked). At 200 rows this is fine; if bookmark volume grows a single $lookup pipeline would be cheaper.
OPTIONAL: photo_reactions still lacks a compound unique index on (photo_id, user_id, reaction_type) — race could insert duplicates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1140 lines — please split into modular routers (recurring recommendation).

GET /api/photos/bookmarks: hotel_name/hotel_destination are resolved from the in-memory HOTELS list. If a hotel is removed from that list the bookmark shows the raw hotel_id as name and empty destination — acceptable given curated hotel data, but should be documented.

In SavedPhotos.jsx react() function: on POST error, load() is re-called AFTER the optimistic mutation. If load() fails silently (e.g., network), the UI stays in an incorrect optimistic state. Consider reverting the optimistic change explicitly on error before calling load().

SavedPhotos lightbox click on the outer overlay uses onClick={() => setLightbox(null)} while the inner content uses e.stopPropagation() — correct. But the like/bookmark buttons in the lightbox rely on default event bubbling; if they later add stopPropagation() the parent close would still work. Fine as-is.

photo_reactions insertions are still not de-duplicated at the index level — a rapid double-click on the heart could race and insert two 'like' rows, which would then be reflected as like_count=2 on GET. Consider unique index (photo_id, user_id, reaction_type).

success_rate.backend: 100% for iter5 new tests (3/3). Full suite iter1-5: 71/71 (100%). Previously flaky test_emails_mine_lists_mocked also passed this run.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — nav-saved-photos visible only when authed, saved-photos-page + saved-photo-<pid> tile render with correct hotel_name+destination, like button toggles orange+count 0→1, tile click opens saved-lightbox with saved-lightbox-unsave, unsave click removes tile + closes lightbox + shows saved-photos-empty. Unauth: saved-photos-unauth block renders and nav 'Saved' link is hidden.

Frontend used a dedicated 'fe5-user-1784135541321' with one paid htl_01 booking, one uploaded photo, one bookmark reaction — all cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: iter5 pytest seeds one paid booking to htl_01 and htl_03, uploads 2 PNGs (one per hotel), bookmarks both via POST /api/photos/{id}/reactions and likes the first, then asserts enriched GET /api/photos/bookmarks. Frontend E2E seeded a session token + paid htl_01 booking + one uploaded photo + one bookmark reaction; verified UI flow; cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter5 tests at /app/backend/tests/test_travelo_iter5.py. GET /api/photos/bookmarks response contract: list of photo dicts with photo_id, hotel_id, user_id, user_name, user_picture, storage_path, caption, created_at, url (starts with /api/files/), hotel_name (from in-memory HOTELS list, falls back to hotel_id), hotel_destination (from HOTELS, falls back to ''), like_count, bookmark_count, my_liked (bool reflecting caller), my_bookmarked=true always, no _id. Order = photo_reactions.created_at DESC of the caller's bookmark rows. Toggle-off unbookmark removes photo from list. All iter1-4 tests still green. Mocked flows unchanged (Razorpay demo, Google Places curated, Resend mock, Object storage local FS). Concierge still LIVE Claude Sonnet 4.5.
